nb2_lite.texto: An uprooted green town-name road sign with its torn steel posts. Lies face-up in the red dirt beside the outback highway after being pulled out. Pilbara highway turn-off in 2007, red earth verge, spinifex, empty road. Soft low late-afternoon light. Medium shot, low angle near the ground, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 2007, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio.
